address: 2 South Embankment, Dartmouth, TQ6 9BH, United Kingdom
bio: Experienced chef Elly Wentworth is at the helm of this iconic riverside restaurant; a smart yet informal space set on the ground floor of a historic building looking out onto the harbour. Accomplished, boldly flavoured dishes showcase the best produce from within a 30-mile radius. Service is friendly and efficient. Tasting menu only on Friday and Saturday evenings....
